newsitem.title: USA: Patterson Energy developing Texas tract.
newsitem.headline: Patterson Energy developing Texas tract.

text.p: Patterson Energy Inc said it completed two confirmation wells in Robertson County, Texas and the drilling of two additional wells in the field.

As previously reported, the Georgette Smith No. 1 discovery well was completed in November 1996 in the Georgetown formation. This well continues to produce 900 barrels of crude oil per day, the company said.
It said the first delineation well in the field, the Ortiz No. 1 well, was a stepout well located one-half mile to the west of the Georgette Smith well.
The Ortiz well was put on production in February and is now producing 1,000 barrels of oil per day.

In late April, the second delineation well, the Sandifer No. 1 well, located three miles northwest of the initial well, was also completed and put on production and at 1,100 barrels of crude oil per day.
Patterson Energy said it has a 17.25 percent interest in the Georgette Smith and Ortiz wells and a 23.75 percent interest in the Sandifer well and is operator for all three.
The company said its net interest in the combined production from the three wells is 500 barrels of oil per day.

Patterson said it is drilling of two additional development wells in the field. The FNB No. 1 well is being drilled three miles northeast of the Georgette Smith well and the Blair No. 1, a re-entry of an existing well, is drilling eight miles west of the initial well.
The company said it has identified additional locations in the 39,000 acre prospect area and plans to continue an active drilling program in the field throughout 1997.
